controls_ui_gate_commands.name: design-validator
command:
import pathlib, tempfile, shutil, subprocess
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="ifpmic-gate-") as temp:
 target=pathlib.Path(temp)/"design"
 shutil.copytree("docs/ifpmic/design-v1",target)
 subprocess.run(["python3",str(target/"verify_design.py")],check=True)

limitations: No build, test, service, or network command was executed for this collection.
Pre-build output hashes do not establish a post-build match; the G6 build and plugin build must run.

A matching UI inventory/output set supports only conditional omission of the listed UI/browser gate; G6 acceptance still requires the approved targeted/full Node and Python suites, source and output comparisons, protected originals, and final independent review.
This baseline is an input for G6 contract/review, not G6 acceptance or full B02/original AT acceptance.
